title: Anti-blocking admission
description: Objective: enforce dependency necessity, approved-interface alternatives, semantic reduction, plan quality, and bounded blocker challenge before multi-node activation. Deliverable: scheduler admission modules with counterexamples. NOT in scope: execution dispatch or automatic graph rewrite. Hard dependencies: Dependency contract kernel. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/admission/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Unnecessary hard edges are rejected or held with stable reasons.
Interface-first alternatives and intentional waits are represented without inventing readiness.
Admission is deterministic and never auto-removes a semantic edge.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red then green — src/admission/admission-necessity.ts (+ shim) + tests folded into admission-pass.test.ts or a focused block. RESOLVED (no open questions in an approved plan): positive controls are a TEST-TIME obligation (design 409 'Admission PROPERTIES include matched positive controls'; running consumer oracles is impossible in a pure pass, design 392) — admission NEVER refuses a graph for missing counterexample bundles. What admission-necessity DOES: (1) typed per-edge outcomes for agent-claimed necessity (design 407): AGENT_REPORTED 'why necessary' NEVER admits a hard edge — outcomes are (a) ADMISSIBLE via daemon-verifiable witness (truthClass floor DAEMON_VERIFIED), (b) ADMISSION_HELD_FOR_HUMAN_DECISION — the typed HELD outcome DoD 1 requires ('rejected or HELD with stable reasons'): a pure RECORD carrying the pending edge-specific human decision ref + the would-be POLICY_SEQUENCE conversion (with added stages/critical-path cost from the landed structural analysis) — NO lifecycle transitions, no Blocker/PlanningHold states (kernel fence); (c) REFUSED or DOWNGRADED-to-advisory; human approval records the decision but does not upgrade the underlying fact's truth class (design 398); (2) AdmissionCounterexample as an OPTIONAL validated evidence SHAPE (digest-bound fixture refs, matched per-edge, false-edge fixtures) consumed by the TEST matrix — shape validation only, outcome truth stays at supplied truthClass; (3) reuse landed analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals (dependencyNecessity UNKNOWN, requiresSemanticProof, reviewOnly) as the structural counterfactual record — never redefined. Property obligations in tests: for every admitted graph fixture, removing each known-required edge flips the counterfactual/readiness evidence; every false-edge fixture refuses — the positive-control matrix lives HERE in the tests (CORE-S13/J6), not as runtime input demands.

TDD RED then GREEN. RED verified first: `Cannot find module './admission-necessity.js'`. GREEN now: 62/62 focused tests across both admission test files, `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck` exit 0.

evaluateNecessityClaim(claim, validatedContract, landedCounterfactual) -> AdmissionNecessityResult. Effective truth class = claim.truthClass when it equals contract.necessity.truthClass, else fail-closed UNKNOWN (never the higher of the two — that would be laundering by max). Outcome table, total over the 5-class vocabulary: DAEMON_VERIFIED -> ADMISSIBLE; AGENT_REPORTED -> HELD when a humanDecisionRef is pending, REFUSED otherwise; OBSERVED/HUMAN_APPROVED -> DOWNGRADED_ADVISORY (real but not daemon-verifiable, so never a hard blocker); UNKNOWN -> REFUSED. AGENT_REPORTED therefore has NO path to ADMISSIBLE — the human-decision path yields HELD carrying truthClass AGENT_REPORTED unchanged plus the POLICY_SEQUENCE conversion cost, exactly the design-398 rule that a decision is recorded but never upgrades the fact.

HELD is a pure record: test pins its key set exactly to [code, counterexample, edgeKey, humanDecisionRef, kind, policySequenceConversion, structuralCounterfactual, truthClass] and asserts zero keys matching /status|state|transition|recheck|schedul|blocker/ on both the outcome and the conversion — no Blocker/PlanningHold lifecycle is re-invented.

POLICY_SEQUENCE conversion cost is DERIVED from the landed analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals record (structuralStageReduction, alternateHardPathPresent, completionClosureIntactWithoutEdge); the counterfactual itself is passed through by reference with dependencyNecessity UNKNOWN and requiresSemanticProof intact — never redefined.

AdmissionCounterexample is OPTIONAL shape validation only (digest-bound fixture refs, edge-matched, false-edge fixture): supplying a valid bundle leaves outcome kind and truth class identical to the no-bundle case (asserted by a matched pair), and no code path refuses a graph for a MISSING bundle. Malformed bundles, an edge-mismatched bundle, and a claim whose edge disagrees with the supplied counterfactual all yield ADMISSION_NECESSITY_CLAIM_MALFORMED.

Positive-control matrix lives in the tests (design 409): every known-required edge of the admitted fixture flips its structural counterfactual evidence when removed, and each of the 5 rejected witness kinds is asserted as a MATCHED PAIR — the same graph admitted with TYPED_CONTRACT witnesses (positive control, zero issues) and refused with the rejected kind (negative control).

admission-wait.ts (157 lines) — representation + admission-time validation ONLY. validateIntentionalWait: design-235 shape (waitRef, ownerNodeKey, reason, typed predicate, affectedScope, recheckAtGate, deadlineGate, escalation kind+ref, graph/fact binding) with ADMISSION_WAIT_MALFORMED on shape violations (empty scope, duplicate scope entries, blank reason, unknown escalation kind, unknown gate — each asserted) and ADMISSION_WAIT_HORIZON_INVALID when the recheck gate is beyond the deadline, computed with the LANDED isWithinHorizon rather than a re-implemented gate order. admitDependencyChallenge delegates entirely to the landed validateDependencyChallenge and passes its DEPENDENCY_CHALLENGE_* codes through UNCHANGED — asserted for DEPENDENCY_CHALLENGE_CONTRACT_NOT_CURRENT (the design-419 SEMANTIC_PREREQUISITE current-contract reference) and DEPENDENCY_CHALLENGE_FOREIGN_HOLD; dedup identity, mutual-hold refusal and graph-epoch/source-fact binding stay the kernel's rules, never re-coded here. isTimeChallengeSuppressed(wait, currentGate, hasNewEvidence) is a pure predicate: it returns false for ANY non-`false` evidence flag (new evidence always wins, design 415), false for an unvalidated wait, false for a non-gate "now", and true only inside the declared deadline — it fails OPEN, never silently suppressing.

There is NO clock in the module: "now" is the caller's current consumption gate, so the determinism rail holds. The module header names the four out-of-scope areas explicitly (challenge enqueueing and timer/transaction re-evaluation -> readiness engine task-fa96b81c; Blocker lifecycle design 234; supersession carry -> graph supersession engine; readiness computation -> landed partitionFrontier).
